variants.specifics: Brackenford: Ossian at the Drowned Lantern, Dunstan the smith, Mabry the magic seller.

inn.speaker: Ossian
inn.text: Sorry, I don't serve folk without coin.

arms.speaker: Dunstan
arms.text: Well... Maybe not the newest exactly... But solid all the same!

magic.speaker: Mabry
magic.text: I hear you came through the Ashwood. Well done, stranger!

variants.specifics: Skarn Delve: The inn, arms shop and magic shop of Skarn Delve

inn.speaker: Dugga
inn.text: Thirsty folk are always welcome here. What can I pour for you?

arms.speaker: Kragg
arms.text: It's awful quiet today, with the Troll scare and all.

variants.specifics: Gorrow: Bidda the innkeeper, Krunk the arms seller, Mirelda of the magic shop

inn.speaker: Bidda
inn.text: You look like you could use a bed, friend.

arms.speaker: Krunk
arms.text: Pssst! Hey! Stranger! Want a blade? Cheapest in the marsh and it was hammered together right here in Gorrow!

magic.speaker: Mirelda
magic.text: Go away, stranger! I don't sell to FROG-KILLERS!

variants.specifics: Karth Vael: Gorlick keeps the inn, Zibbet the arms shop, Vexel the magic shop in Karth Vael.

inn.speaker: Gorlick
inn.text: Are you here to join the garrison?

arms.speaker: Zibbet
arms.text: You'd better be quick the garrison's buying up all my steel.

magic.speaker: Vexel
magic.text: Yes, what is it, stranger? I'm rather occupied.

variants.specifics: Orlmere: Gorbel at the inn, Drusk the smith, Ismene at the magic shop.

inn.speaker: Gorbel
inn.text: Stranger, eh? You'd best head back where you came from. No doubt Zorvane will be raising the dead in the next village soon, too! Strange times we live in, eh?

arms.speaker: Drusk
arms.text: Haven't seen many strangers lately. Orlmere isn't exactly a good place for a holiday these days, what with the drowned wandering out of the lake.

magic.speaker: Ismene
magic.text: Drifters aren't welcome here. But for a little extra, I'll sell to you anyway.

variants.specifics: Zorreth: Pippet of the Singed Quill inn, Hobb the smith, Varna the magic seller.

inn.speaker: Pippet
inn.text: Dark days, lad. I can't believe Maldrek turned on the college. Dire news indeed! Better rest up while you can!

arms.speaker: Hobb
arms.text: Welcome to Hobb's Iron and Steel. I believe I still have a few good blades in stock.

magic.speaker: Varna
magic.text: Hello, kind sir. I'm nearly ready to pack up and leave town. Everything must go, if you're interested.

variants.specifics: Kell Varn: Brisa the innkeeper, Dagg the smith, Mylka of the magic shop

inn.speaker: Brisa
inn.text: Hope you don't need a room any time soon, lad. You seem to have plenty left to do.

arms.speaker: Dagg
arms.text:
Wanna see a new blade?

I call it 'Ogre's Lullaby.'

magic.speaker: Mylka
magic.text: So, you carry both the Staff of Thaw and the Warden's Key. Well done, brave Adventurer!

variants.specifics: Ashkar: Hettie the innkeeper, Skeld the armsmith, Ilsa the potion seller.

inn.speaker: Hettie
inn.text: Sorry, I can't give you a room. The smiths have all taken beds.

arms.speaker: Skeld
arms.text: Pssst! Over here! Are you wanting a sharp sword? Some armor, maybe?

magic.speaker: Ilsa
magic.text: Sorry friend, you've bought me dry! I've no potions left to give you.

variants.specifics: Tolmar Cross: Pegg keeps the inn, Kolb the arms shop, Zillah the magic shop.

inn.speaker: Pegg
inn.text: Maybe you'd like a hot meal or a room?

arms.speaker: Kolb
arms.text:
Stranger from the south, eh? Most folk around here don't trust your sort, but they've never even been to the Hollow and I have! What do they know!? Eh? Heh, heh, heh...

You're always welcome here, sir.

magic.speaker: Zillah
magic.text: Watch your step in my shop, stranger! I've got plenty of scrolls here that'll singe your eyebrows off.

variants.specifics: Tosk: Mugg of the Plow and Pitcher inn, Grint the smith and Quenby the magic seller greet the player.

inn.speaker: Mugg
inn.text: Sorry, friend, but my rooms have filled up somewhat. Ogres tend to make the farm folk crowd into town. Heh, heh, heh...

arms.speaker: Grint
arms.text: Wanna buy a scythe? They're salvaged from the vast scrap heaps of Ulm Gorra.

magic.speaker: Quenby
magic.text: Word gets around. Out of my shop, before I test a scroll on your head!
